rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for the hard shell around a nut kernel.

example.english: The nutshell of this walnut is very hard, so be careful when peeling it.
example.traditional: 呢粒合桃嘅果仁殼好硬，剝嗰陣要小心。
example.jyutping: ne1 nap1 hap6 tou4 ge3 gwo2 jan4 hok3 hou2 ngaang6 mok1 go2 zan6 jiu3 siu2 sam1

rows.note: Use this for a short booklet that condenses an area of law, rather than for a general legal summary.

example.english: This legal nutshell explains tenancy law clearly in just a few pages.
example.traditional: 呢本法律小冊子用幾頁紙講清楚租務法例。
example.jyutping: ne1 bun2 faat3 leot6 siu2 caak3 zi2 jung6 gei2 jip6 zi2 gong2 cing1 co2 zou1 mou6 faat3 lai6
